# The title the theme prints

A paragraph with an <kbd>Esc</kbd> key and {/* a comment that vanishes */} nothing else.

<Tabs>
  <TabItem value="npm" label="npm">

```bash
npm install thing
```

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="yarn" label="Yarn">

```bash
yarn add thing
```

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

<Details summary="Why it works this way">

Because tabs need script, and a page does not have any.

</Details>

<Admonition type="tip" title="Worth knowing">

Admonitions written as components work too.

</Admonition>
